additional_source.use: worker-only native Qwen3.8 model loader; source is imported, not copied

modifications: Original mlx2 worker IPC and default-off profile boundary; no TensorFold source copied.
Require clean pinned TensorFold and mlx-lm-unified source checkouts, hash key source bytes and all target/drafter safetensors bytes before loading.
Run native TensorFold model installation, serial and tree forwards, and cache commits only inside a dedicated child process because its installers replace global MLX callables.
Give the worker a distinct numerical identity and reserved APCv2 namespace. APCv2 state publication remains disabled until a cache bridge is implemented and qualified.

Add a default-off token-only live admission and round API using TensorFold LaneEngine. At one active stream native tree drafting is eligible; at multiple streams queued drafts are discarded and the pinned shared hidden_rows path verifies one ordinary row per stream. Caches never leave the worker.

Add an opt-in HTTP token-ID endpoint to the existing mlx2 service with a dedicated router thread owning worker IPC. Restrict to greedy Qwen3.8 tokens, never use APCv2 lookup/store for worker requests, and emit unqualified per-request route and draft-count receipts. Same-worker B1 serial is an explicit performance control.

Add an explicit X-MLX2-TensorFold-Owned header for greedy text chat/completion requests, using adapter prompt rendering, tokenizer decode, and worker EOS semantics. Fail closed on unsupported sampling/capabilities and keep ordinary unheaded requests unchanged.

Adapt only the HTTP admission and receipt layer of the frozen Spomin 20-domain by 20-case benchmark. Reuse its corpus, prepare_case, make_body, and acceptance code; preserve source reconciliation, 40 immutable capped cell receipts, and one source/worker identity across full-suite scoring.

In a separate research branch, add a fail-closed serial-control header and emitted-token digest for complete-request B1 tree versus native serial pairs on exact frozen Spomin full/compacted transcripts. This does not change the default or frozen 40-cell quality campaign.

Add an explicit cache-disabled receipt through native worker and router, plus a bounded route-specific feature screen; omitted greedy options are normalized only within the owned header. No default or qualification state is changed.

Cancel an owned native request when its HTTP peer disconnects, close a session cancelled during prefill before any decode round, and expose aggregate worker admission counts without publishing cache data.

Record host-monotonic native admission-to-first-token prefill timing and per-round token-ready timestamps, separate router queue wait and client HTTP wall, and retain actual native active-width counts. Report effective prompt throughput and post-first-token decode throughput without treating queue or HTTP wall as model compute.

Treat 192/64 completion caps as upper bounds: accept a valid early EOS stop, require length finishes to reach their cap, retain exact control usage/finish and ordered actual transition requirements.
